entries.title: The keyboard stays where you left it
entries.body: When you switch back to the app while working in the task board, a card or a panel, the keyboard is still on the tile or field you left. Before, it could be lost when a decision waited behind the board, and the arrow keys did nothing until you clicked.
entries.noPicture: The fix is where the keyboard's focus goes when the window comes forward, which a still picture cannot show.
